question.text: If the distance between the plane, <math><mn>23</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>10</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>z</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>48</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> and the plane containing the lines <math><mfrac><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>z</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> and <math><mfrac><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>z</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mi>λ</mi></mrow></mfrac><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>λ</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>R</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to <math><mfrac><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mrow><msqrt><mn>633</mn></msqrt></mrow></mfrac><mo>,</mo></math> then <math><mi>k</mi></math> is equal to ____________.

solution.text:
Lines must be intersecting

⇒2s-1,4s+3,3s-1=2t-3,6t-2,λt+1
2s-1=2t-3,4s+3=6t-2,3s-1=λt+1⇒t=12,s=-12,λ=-7

Distance of plane contains given lines from given plane is same as distance between point -3,-2,1 from given plane.

Required distance equal to

-69+20-2+48529+100+4=3633=k633⇒k=3
